AcceptIn.description:
The versions the user read on the acceptance screen, for one role. The 18+ declaration
must be true (minors cannot contract).
AcceptIn.title: AcceptIn

AccountDeleted.description:
The server holds none of the grower's records or photos any more.
`sign_in_account_removed` is false when the sign-in account is left for the owner to
remove by hand (no service role key configured, or Supabase did not answer).
AccountDeleted.title: AccountDeleted

BadgeOut.description:
What was checked and when; the app words it "checked on <date>", never a guarantee.
`checked`: an admin approval on record; `registered_from`: the registration GPS fix's
place; `place_photo`: a BagMitra representative's visit photo.
BadgeOut.title: BadgeOut

BlockedClaimOut.description:
A label row whose active ingredient is banned, or restricted for this crop: shown in
red so the grower knows it, never with a dose.
BlockedClaimOut.title: BlockedClaimOut

BuyerIn.description:
A trader or an exporter: firm, the markets / villages they buy in, crops, and the
registration numbers they hold (stored for the admin's manual check).
BuyerIn.title: BuyerIn

FeedAdminDatesIn.description: All four dates at once: a missing or `null` date is cleared.
FeedAdminDatesIn.title: FeedAdminDatesIn

FeedPreferencesBody.description:
Quiet hours are India local times "HH:MM" (start inclusive, end exclusive; equal
means no quiet hours). `weekly_cap` counts alert pushes in any rolling 7 days.
FeedPreferencesBody.title: FeedPreferencesBody

GrievanceOfficerOut.description: IT Rules 2021 grievance officer. `name` null: the owner (default, spec §4C).
GrievanceOfficerOut.title: GrievanceOfficerOut

MyProfileOut.description: The registrant's own view: status of the latest check and why the admin looks at it.
MyProfileOut.title: MyProfileOut

get.description: The review queue by default (`status=in_review`), newest first.

post.description: Manual upload: metadata, optional document (hashed), optional text. Lands in review.

Classify and summarise the item's text into a review draft (AI off without
FEED_AI_API_KEY). Irrelevant documents move to `draft`, out of the queue.

put.description:
Replace deadline / payment / validity dates (a missing or `null` date is cleared). The
dates are output-checked against the stored text; a change to a published item clears its
approval and sends it back to review (an `edited` event with `reopened: true`); the
farmer-facing deadlines are rebuilt when it is published again. Withdrawn: 409.

Record the owner's check of the source's terms of use and robots. Also clears a
recorded fetch failure, so the next scheduled run tries once more.

Record a document an admin downloaded by hand (the server could not fetch it). The body
is the raw file; only its hash, size and time are kept.

post.description:
Admin adds a provider it knows (no account of its own, spec §2); it waits in the queue
for a decision like any other (Q72).

get.description: Every tag, drafts and retired ones included.

put.description: Edit the three labels and set draft / active / retired (spec §3A: admin only).

get.description: Subjects waiting for a check (latest record pending, or none yet), oldest first.
The subject's submitted fields, documents and every verification record.

post.description: Approve, or reject with a reason: always a new record with who and when (Q70).

get.description: A short-lived signed URL for one stored document; only keys on record are signed.

post.description: Store prices typed in from a mandi's published rate list (same day and mandi replace).

get.description: Latest and minimum app version codes (0 = not set) and where to download the APK.

Newest first. `district` / `crop` narrow the list to items meant for them (items for
everyone always pass); `may_be_eligible_because` is computed from the caller's own
profile and plots.

post.description:
Compares the pasted text with published official items only. Never says a message is
fake: without a match the note says none was found and points to the official portal.
Hide the item from the caller's pushes (reminders and digest stop for it).

Record that the caller wants this item's date reminders even if it was not matched to
their profile; undoes a dismiss. Only for a published item that has a date.

get.description: Enrolment dates of published official crop insurance notices, soonest first.
The general part of every live knowledge card (newest version per topic and crop).

post.description:
Broker (मध्यस्थ (दलाल)) registration: phone sign-in + GPS fix; the admin then calls
(spec §4 broker rule; no photo ID, no place photo needed).

get.description: What the signed-in user accepted, and the roles it opens.
Every market-link profile of the signed-in user, with its check status.

The list per taluka (decision g): verified traders, exporters or brokers, by rating
(mean of the question averages; unrated last) or by completed deals.
One verified profile; an unverified one answers 404 as if absent.

put.description:
The optional address: only the profile owner or a BagMitra representative sets it
(addendum 2); who and when are stored, and a representative's entry is also a record.

post.description:
A document photo for the admin's check (in-app camera): GSTIN / APMC / FSSAI / IEC /
APEDA for a trader or exporter, the Legal Metrology certificate (with its valid-until
date) for a weighbridge. Owner only; EXIF stripped before storage (spec §4B).

A representative's place photo from a visit (in-app camera, time + GPS): who and when
are stored; EXIF is stripped before storage (addendum 2, spec §4B).

get.description:
Verified providers near the grower's own plot: nearest first when both have a location
(distance in whole km from the provider's registration fix, Q80), the rest by district,
taluka and name. A phone number to call; no booking.

post.description: Service provider registration (one per kind per user) with the GPS fix.

get.description: The active tick list under each rating question (spec §3A); the app caches it.

The current version of each document accepted before a role is used, and the
grievance officer shown on every role home (spec §4C).

post.description:
Record the acceptance of every document for one role. A version that is no longer
current answers 409 `terms_version_changed`, so the app shows the new text again.
Trader registration with the GPS fix; lands in the verification queue.

get.description:
Latest published price (₹ per quintal) at every reporting mandi in India for the crop:
the local APMCs first, then the major terminal markets, then all others by state. Prices
are shown as published, never estimated, and come from storage only (filled by the scheduled
pull; a request never fetches). `stale` says they are not current and `reason` says why.
`scope` narrows the list to local or major mandis.

delete.description:
Erase the caller's account: every record, the sync history, devices, notice receipts,
backed-up photos and (when configured) the sign-in account. It cannot be undone.
Stop push alerts to this phone (sign-out); unknown tokens are ignored.

post.description: Register this phone for push alerts; repeating it is harmless.

get.description: The caller's settings, or the defaults (21:00-07:00, 3 a week, digest on).

Recent and forecast days for the plot's location, with rule-based risk alerts.

Alerts come only from the configured rules (never from AI) and carry no chemical advice.

What CIB&RC registered labels say for the crop (owner, 2026-10-26: label information
only). Only claims valid today whose active ingredient is neither banned nor restricted
for the crop pass the legal gate; doses are quoted exactly as the label states them.
The app shows this as label information with "read the label; confirm with KVK", never
as BagMitra's own advice.

Gazette bans / restrictions and trade names, cached by the app so spray records can
be checked offline. Facts only; no advice text.

post.description:
A signed upload URL for this record's photo (JPEG only, at most `max_bytes`).

The phone PUTs the file to `upload_url` with `Content-Type: image/jpeg`, then records
`photo_key` on the scouting record through the normal outbox.

get.description:
A short-lived signed download URL for a backed-up photo.

Only the key derived from the caller and the record is ever signed (S-03): the stored
`photo_key` is just the flag that a photo exists, and one that does not match the derived
key (written around the sync check) is treated as no photo.

post.description:
Apply a batch of offline mutations. Each mutation gets its own result; the batch
never fails as a whole because of one bad mutation.
